note: _David proficiscens_ (Clementina) – David marching forward. The Latin participle does not make sense here. Loch in his 1862/63 edition replaced it with _proficiens_ – making progress, translating “David stieg” – David ascended (in his German translation of the Old Testament); this is also the reading of the Weber/Gryson edition The NVg has _invalescens_ – growing stronger.
